name: Document Information Panel
description: Windows MDM settings in the Document Information Panel category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Disable Document Information Panel (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether Excel, PowerPoint, and Word users can view document information in the Document Information Panel.The Document Information Panel replaces the modal Properties dialog box in earlier versions of Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, and allows users to view and edit metadata that is associated with the document. Office 2016 developers can create custom Document Information Panels to record a variety of information relevant to the document or the organization. 

If you enable this policy setting, forms and controls do not display in the Document Information Panel. The panel itself will display when users open it, but it will be blank. 

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, users can view the Document Information Panel.

properties.name: Document Information Panel Beaconing UI (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether users see a security warning when they open custom Document Information Panels that contain a Web beaconing threat. InfoPath can be used to create custom Document Information Panels that can be attached to Excel workbooks, PowerPoint presentations, and Word documents. 

If you enable this policy setting, you can choose from three options for controlling when users are prompted about Web beaconing threats: 

- Never show UI 

- Always show UI 

- Show UI if XSN is in Internet Zone 

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, the behavior is the equivalent of setting the policy to Enabled -- Never show UI.

properties.name: Offline Mode for Document Information Panel (User)
properties.description: Specify if Offline Mode is disabled/enabled for custom Document Information Panel templates and if the Document Information Panel is currently in Offline Mode.

properties.name: Trust Local Solution (User)
properties.description:
Suppresses prompt that asks to load a locally installed full-trust solution of a Document Information Panel in the background. This is normally shown if a full-trust solution is deployed and there are bound properties in the document (e.g. lookups) that must load the Document Information Panel in the background to retrieve the contents of the property. 

Enter pairs corresponding to the Document Information Panel solution path and a value of 1 to disable. If the value is set, the user will not be prompted when loading the full-trust solution in the background. The solution will load normally (and any non-related warnings that exist).
